title: Spring results table
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 42 (Spring results table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 42: Springs and stretching. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how a rubber band stretches with load
equipment: Equal loads (for example 50 g packets or coins)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Hang the band from a hook; put the bag on it over a cushion
Measure the length with no load
Add one load and measure again; keep your face back
Work out the extension each time (new length minus original)

questions.q: Beyond the elastic limit a spring...
Big question: why does a spring balance work but an old hair band would not?
questions.a: Springs stretch in proportion to force until the elastic limit; the band is past it.
